descriptor: Meeting room finder for small teams

voice.summary: Sounds like a helpful office manager: concise, specific about capacity and time, and gently funny about thinking rooms. Availability is the headline every time.
dos: Give capacity and equipment in numbers
Show free or booked in the label
Confirm bookings with the time and room name
donts: No apology for a busy diary

taglines: Book the space, not the stress
boilerplate: Roompulse helps small teams compare meeting rooms by capacity and equipment, pick a conflict-free slot and reserve it in seconds.

microcopy.error: That slot was just taken, pick another

logo.note: A pulse line hints at the live availability of every slot.
